scripts.deploy:dev: git pull origin develop --no-edit  && cp .env.production .env && docker-compose -f docker-compose.pro.yml build && docker-compose -f docker-compose.pro.yml up -d
scripts.deploy:main: git pull origin main --no-edit  && cp .env.main .env && docker-compose -f docker-compose.main.yml build && docker-compose -f docker-compose.main.yml up -d
